insights.title: ROSEN, RECOGNIZED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Duolingo, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - DUOL
insights.claim: Rosen Law Firm is urging Duolingo investors who purchased stock between May 2, 2025 and February 26, 2026 to join a securities class action lawsuit. The lawsuit alleges that Duolingo made false statements about user growth by concealing that increased monetization efforts, ad volume, and lower-quality AI-generated content were negatively impacting daily active users and product quality. The lead plaintiff deadline is December 7, 2026.
